title: Besov space approach to the Navier-Stokes equations with the Neumann boundary condition in bounded domains
summary: Based on the analysis by Iwabuchi-Matsuyama-Taniguchi (2019), we first introduce our framework of Besov spaces $\dot B^s_{p, q}$ on the bounded domain $Ω\subset {\mathbb R}^d$ with smooth boundary $\partial Ω$ in terms of the Stokes operator $A=A_2$ with the Neumann boundary condition on $\partialΩ$ in $L^2_σ(Ω)$. Under some geometric assumption on $Ω$, we establish $L^p-L^q$ type estimates of the semi-group $\{e^{-tA}\}_{t \ge 0}$ in $\dot B^s_{p, q}$ and prove a local well-posedness of the Navier-Stokes equations with the initial data in $\dot B^{-1+\frac dp }_{p, q}$ for $d < p < \infty$…
